title: PolyFinance
tagline: All-in-one DEX platform for Decentralized Finance . We want to provide seamless experience of Defi platform to people in Web3( they will able to do everything from one single platform).
description:
A Cross chain all-in-one Defi platform 

Challenges I ran into
Metamask interaction with contracts, the difference between call(), and send(), these took some time to understand. All these days I was experienced with signing my own transaction with private keys in code.
This was my first DeFi project, understanding all the token mechanics, and everything around this was quite hard compared to normal web3 projects.
Covalent did take some time to get used to, I didn't realise I had to decode the output, digging up google to find that was fun.
how_its_made:
Technologies

💨 Polygon Network - Superfast blockchain transactions.



🚀 Morallis- For Polygon Nodes and Server



⌛️ Covalent - Real-time on-chain data via API, for faucet, borrow, and all information across dashboards.



⛓ Chainlink - Price feeds for calculating interest earned in staking RUP (tied to USDC on test net).
